Five extended sections treat Hellenistic states, Ashokan inscriptions, Qin/Han records, Rome from republic to principate, and neighboring Kushite, Aksumite, Nabataean, Parthian, and Kushan worlds. Full three-part narration differentiates Wari and Tiwanaku material/political systems, ayllu and vertical-archipelago models, Inca labor obligations and numeric versus undeciphered khipu. Full narration describes pre-1492 Caribbean settlement, island and mainland ties, cassava, Caguana ceremonial site, Taíno diversity, ancient DNA caveats, and Indigenous continuity after colonization. Complete five-part global survey includes Chimú/Inca, Melaka and Zheng He, Byzantine/Ottoman change, post-plague Europe and many coexisting societies around 1500; expanded description, regional tags and anchored places. No single global date span inferred.

All four sections cover Northwest Coast sea gardens, California oak/tomol practices, Klamath-Trinity fisheries and Columbia Plateau salmon/camas. Existing preview accurate. Replaced misleading Oceanic tag and overly broad Pacific place with specific narrated North American regions.
